## S1 · Trigger & Backlink

> ↩ Originated from: Chapter 1, S3, "What actually kicks off the rollout once
> this is approved?"

The rollout triggers automatically when every checklist item in Chapter 1, S2
reaches `published` status for a given role template. No manual "go" button -
the trigger is the data reaching a known-good state.
